# ElseIf <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
ElseIf condition
Else If condition
```

## Description

Another condition for the block form of [If](If), tested only when the conditions before it were false. `Else If` written as two words means the same.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 15
If n < 10
	Print "small"
ElseIf n < 20
	Print "medium"
Else If n < 30
	Print "large"
EndIf
```

```text
medium
```
